headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants in a shutout victory, while the Chicago Cubs came from behind to defeat the Baltimore Orioles. The Detroit Tigers secured a decisive win over the Athletics, and the Atlanta Braves shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates in a doubleheader.

The Blue Jays' 10-0 win over the Giants was led by Dylan Cease, who pitched 8.0 innings and struck out 11 batters. The Cubs' 9-7 victory over the Orioles featured Pete Crow-Armstrong's impressive performance, including two home runs and two RBIs. The Tigers' 6-1 win over the Athletics was backed by their strong pitching staff, with Spencer Torkelson leading the offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

The Braves' 3-0 shutout victory over the Pirates was led by Dylan Dodd, while Joey Bart contributed with a home run and two RBIs. In the second game of the doubleheader, the Braves secured a 10-5 win over the Pirates, with Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin among the impact hitters.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Tanner Banks of the Philadelphia Phillies, Brad Lord of the Washington Nationals, Owen Caissie of the Miami Marlins, John King of the Miami Marlins, Tim Herrin of the Cleveland Guardians, Ranger Suarez of the Boston Red Sox, Connor Prielipp of the Minnesota Twins, and Samad Taylor of the San Diego Padres.

There have been several trades and roster movements, including the New York Mets acquiring Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash, the Detroit Tigers trading Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash, the Philadelphia Phillies trading Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and the Houston Astros trading Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Dominate Giants in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 10-0 win over the San Francisco Giants, behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 8.0 innings, striking out 11 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Cubs Come from Behind to Defeat Orioles 9-7**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a thrilling 9-7 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Pete Crow-Armstrong leading the charge at the plate. Crow-Armstrong's impressive performance included two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Athletics 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a decisive victory over the Athletics, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Dylan Dodd earning the win. Joey Bart led the Braves' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with multiple players contributing to the winning effort. Impact hitters for the Braves included Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin, while Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Lane Thomas and Bobby Witt Jr. leading the charge for the losing team. Sean Manaea was among the standout pitchers for the Royals.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Tanner Banks on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Philadelphia Phillies left-handed pitcher Tanner Banks has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
